skirmish.module.invisible_highlight.name: Invisible Highlight
skirmish.module.invisible_highlight.desc: Highlights the top of the block an invisible player stands on (HolyWorld's rules allow this). Not through walls; while they jump, their last block stays lit for a second.
skirmish.module.invisible_highlight.sett: A translucent fill of the top face besides the outline
The highlight gently pulses so it is easier to notice
